name: Touri Tsubasa
source: A carefree underclassman. She is quite a genius in everything she desires to do, and has gained the envy of the girls around her because of her gorgeous appearance. In fact, Tsubasa is popular with the boys and already considered to be the next Miss Aonanafune Academy.
